zg361_pp_resolve_w_outcome_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_pp_w_completed = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized
			var:zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved = 1
			var:zg361_pp_w_exit_cost_conserved = 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_outcome value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_evidence_led > var:zg361_pp_w_political } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_outcome value = 1 } add_prestige = 25 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_political > var:zg361_pp_w_evidence_led } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_outcome value = -1 } add_stress = minor_stress_gain }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_portfolio_done_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_ai = no } }
			save_scope_as = zg361_pp_completion_subject
			# Retain the queue lock through the visible completion card, otherwise a
			# same-day central adapter call could overlap it with the next domain.
			var:zg361_case_w_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.9004 days = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			# The authorized AI route has no visible card and releases immediately.
			var:zg361_case_w_owner = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 0 } }
		}
		debug_log = "ZG361PP: completed W runtime case"
	}
